arxiv-2206-00568.title: RMT-Net: Reject-aware Multi-Task Network for Modeling Missing-not-at-random Data in Financial Credit Scoring
arxiv-2206-00568.creator: Qiang Liu, Yingtao Luo, Shu Wu, Zhen Zhang, Xiangnan Yue, Hong Jin, and Liang Wang
arxiv-2206-00568.description: Abstract In financial credit scoring, loan applications may be approved or rejected. We can only observe default/non-default labels for approved samples but have no observations for rejected samples, which leads to missing-not-at-random selection bias. Machine learning models trained on such biased data are inevitably unreliable.

arxiv-2206-10662.title: Accurate and consistent calculation of the mean and variance in Monte-Carlo simulations
arxiv-2206-10662.creator: Jherek Healy
arxiv-2206-10662.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jherek Healy. In parallelized Monte-Carlo simulations, the order of summation is not always the same. When the mean is calculated in running fashion, this may create an artificial randomness in results which ought to be reproducible. This note takes a look at the problem and proposes to combine the running mean and variance algorithm with an accurate and robust summing algorithm in order to increase the accuracy and robustness of the Monte-Carlo estimates.

arxiv-2301-02692.title: Isotonic Recalibration under a Low Signal-to-Noise Ratio
arxiv-2301-02692.creator: Mario V. Wüthrich, Johanna Ziegel
arxiv-2301-02692.description: Abstract Insurance pricing systems should fulfill the auto-calibration property to ensure that there is no systematic cross-financing between different price cohorts. Often, regression models are not auto-calibrated. We propose to apply isotonic recalibration to a given regression model to ensure auto-calibration.

arxiv-2303-17744.title: Detecting Nanometer-Scale New Forces with Coherent Neutron Scattering

arxiv-2303-17744.description: Abstract Significant effort has been devoted to searching for new fundamental forces of nature. At short length scales (below approximately 10 nm), the strongest experimental constraints come from neutron scattering from individual nuclei in gases. The leading experiments at longer length scales instead measure forces between macroscopic test masses.

arxiv-2405-10195.title: Formation pathways of the compact stellar systems
arxiv-2405-10195.creator: J. K. Jang, Sukyoung K. Yi, Soo-Chang Rey, Jinsu Rhee, Yohan Dubois, Taysun Kimm, Christophe Pichon, Katarina Kraljic, Suk Kim
arxiv-2405-10195.description: Abstract The formation pathways of compact stellar systems (CSSs) are still under debate. We utilize the NewHorizon simulation to investigate the origins of such objects in the field environment. We identified 55 CSS candidates in the simulation whose properties are similar to those of the observed ultra-compact dwarfs and compact ellipticals.

pmc-13429625.creator: Kai-Cheng Wang
pmc-13429625.description: Accurate forecasting of non-stationary time series remains challenging due to complex volatility.
